critique.friction: Continue-tap tax on every MC card. After answering an MC, the card requires a second interaction (the Continue button) before the next question — even on a correct components/reverse answer where the only feedback is the two-word line 'nailed it.' On desktop Enter/Space works via the window keydown listener, but on a phone (where he'll actually cram) that is 2 taps × 41 questions on /test and on /allergens, every run, multiplied by however many retakes the weekend holds. That's hundreds of pure-overhead taps across the sprint.
